summary: Frontend-only verification of kanban column scroll feature (max 10 tasks visible, scroll beyond). Tested on /projects/project-1/kanban as admin. All scenarios passed: long column 'Belum Mulai' (16 tasks) got ck-cards-scroll class with maxHeight=1128px and overflowY=auto; short column 'Dikerjakan' had no scroll (maxHeight='none', overflowY='visible'). Internal scroll reveals TEST_scroll 12. Quick-add button 'Tambah task' stays below the scroll area. Card click opens task drawer. Drag & drop of a scrolled-only card (TEST_scroll 12) from Belum Mulai -> Dikerjakan succeeded and persisted after reload (BM 16->15, DK 1->2). Mobile 390px: board horizontal scroll (scrollWidth 1644px) is confined to the board (documentElement.scrollWidth stays 390 == clientWidth) so no page-level horizontal overflow; long column still scrolls internally.
critical_code_review_comments: ColumnCards measurement computes maxHeight from first 10 cards' heights only; if later cards (index >=10) are taller after render the maxHeight could clip them. Not a functional bug for current data but may surprise with variable card sizes (e.g. tag-heavy cards). Consider using fixed row-height or measuring an average/median.

ResizeObserver only observes the first 10 children; if those unmount (filtering/search) during the same mount, observers may become stale. useLayoutEffect dep is only `count`, so changes in child content don't retrigger measure. Minor edge case.
seed_data_creation: No new data created by tester. Pre-existing 13 TEST_scroll 0..12 tasks were used; one of them (TEST_scroll 12) was moved from Belum Mulai -> Dikerjakan to validate drag persistence. Main agent should move TEST_scroll 12 back or delete all TEST_scroll tasks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login requires math captcha solved via DOM: fetch [data-testid=captcha-question] inner_text, parse 'a op b', fill [data-testid=captcha-answer]. Use locator.press_sequentially() instead of fill() for react controlled inputs. After my test TEST_scroll 12 lives in 'Dikerjakan' (project-1) instead of 'Belum Mulai' so Belum Mulai now holds 15 tasks (still >10, still scrolls).
